svg.title: One event loop per worker. Block it and everyone waits.
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “One event loop per worker. Block it and everyone waits.” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. A request path from socket through uvicorn, Starlette and FastAPI to your handler, feeding a single event loop drawn as a circle inside a dashed worker-process boundary. Three branches leave the loop: an async handler that awaits and yields at 470 requests per second, an async handler containing a blocking call which is crossed out in red at 16.9 requests per second, and a plain def handler served by a forty-thread pool at 538. Bars at concurrency 200 compare 2565, 655 and 16.9 requests per second.
svg.text: One event loop per worker. Block it and everyone waits.
